source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned 2-page paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. Header prints '1st SEMESTER EXAMINATION, 2022 -2023', 'CLASS 7', 'MATHEMATICS', 'MARKS 25' and a time read as '1½ HRS.' (the fraction is blurred and could be 1¼; verify); examYear 2023 is the later year of the printed academic year. No school name printed. Section A (Attempt all questions): I and II (5 marks each). Section B (Attempt any 3 questions): III-VII (5 marks each); a pick-3-of-5 choice, not an OR pair, so choiceGroup is not used and all are included; the pack total (35) therefore exceeds the maximum (25) by design. Parts are split with their printed marks. Fractions and powers are written inline (a b/c for mixed numbers, ^ for powers). An ink blot on the scan obscures a term in II b); figures are not reproduced. The paper's own wording ('decimal from', 'same no.', 'ration', 'two number', 'rational number') is kept as printed.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
